summary.en: While a page holds, a 3 px ink frame hops over its items in reading order, one hop a beat, landing on the beat.
summary.zh: 页面停留时，一个 3 px 墨框按阅读顺序在条目间跳，每拍一跳，正好落在拍点上。

fits: The hold of any plakat page with two or more items: rows, options, nodes.
notFor: Pages still landing (it starts once settled); single-item pages; dark films where a frame reads as a selection UI.

intent.en: Keep the beat on a still page without rewriting it: one small frame moves, the content stays readable.
intent.zh: 在静止的页面上保持节拍而不重写画面：只有一个小框在动，内容照样好读。

content.en: The page's item rects in reading order.
content.zh: 页面上各条目的矩形，按阅读顺序。

fits.zh: 任何有两项以上的 plakat 页的停留段：行、选项、节点。

notFor.zh: 还在落定中的页面（它从静止后才开始）；只有一项的页；框会被读成选中界面的暗色片。

en: Above about 140 BPM a hop each beat reads as nervous; walk every second beat there.
zh: 约 140 BPM 以上每拍一跳显得急，改成每两拍一跳。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
